summary: THE 'Start New' front door. Begin a project from an INTENTION (not existing code): record a durable workspace identity + intent + authority and seed the first journal entry. No domain required.

intent.description: one sentence: what this project is for. REQUIRED - genesis begins a project from this intention.

name.description: a name for the project (default: untitled-project)

authority.description: optional authority ceiling recorded for this workspace (a hint; enforcement stays with governance)

profile.description: optional profile HINT (e.g. python-app). A suggestion recorded on the workspace, never a forced identity.

overwrite.description: replace an existing workspace identity (its recorded intent changes). Refused without this.

apply.description: record for real. Without it you get a no-write preview.

workspace.description: the recorded identity: workspace_id, name, intent, authority, profile_hint, created_at

journal_seeded.description: whether the first journal entry was written (best-effort through the seam)

provenance.note: E3. Makes 'Start New' first-class and converges it onto the same observe->act loop as attach. Writes only sidecar state (workspace.json + journal); nothing into the target. attach reads workspace.json and maps at whatever evidence density exists.
